notes.title: Patch 1.2.07A&B
notes.content:
Thanks to feedback from players we have identified and fixed the following:

Bug during haggle minigame where the price would drop unexpectedly. 
Added SFX to haggle criticisms when they strike the painting. 
Haggle criticisms now disappear and impact price the moment they get beyond the haggle paddle.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.07
notes.content:
In this patch the following changes have been made:

 Sales People / Construction People, and Local Artists will now permit each other to spawn rather than preventing it.
 Local artists will now stay stationary throughout dialogues.
 Gallery music now extends to the subbasement apartment.

The following bugs have been identified & fixed:

 Certain dialogues will no longer permanently freeze the player's movement.
 Quests that require the player to fund an artist will now hide their tooltip once funded to discourage generous players from funding multiple times.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.06A
notes.content:
The following bugs have been identified & fixed:

 Sales person / Construction person will spawn and respawn as intended, instead of spawning 2&1 times per game session.
 Artists who identify their name during dialogue will maintain the same name throughout.
 Player will no longer be able to spam click "fund" buttons available in certain questlines. 


Please continue to identify bugs both game-breaking and visual! We appreciate your support.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.06
notes.content:
Thanks to feedback from our day 1 players we have identified and fixed the following:


 Visual bug where local artists might walk in place (requiring the player to close their shop in order to force the artist to leave). Local artists should now no longer walk in place. 
 Error where the painting info card "maximum positive impressions" was populating as 1 lower than intended.
 We have also added the version number (1.2.06) to the main menu, for ease of identifying which patch players are launching.
